{{Top|leg}}
A '''lifting skeleton''' was a specialized [[exoskeleton]] used to lift cargo. The skeleton had a cage to protect the wearer from falling cargo, and two arms ending in clamps. The lifting skeleton's feet included magnetic locks to allow it to operate in zero-[[Gravity/Legends|gravity]].<ref name="SSR">''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]''</ref>
